The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tiragga]]'s '''second moon''' was the site of a [[Tiragga Alliance outpost|Rebel outpost]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Moon/Legends|moon]] had hot springs suitable for bathing in.
